title: Kamala Surayya's birth chart
metaDescription: Kamala Surayya's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 9.9° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 9.9° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 9.9° into Aries — the first decan, which the old scheme hands to Mars. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 12.2° Pisces, Venus was at 24.7° Aquarius, Mars was at 13.0° Aries. Read together: thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that begins as conversation; effort spent in bursts and openings.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Venus and Saturn: 0.2° from an exact conjunction. A conjunction concentrates rather than balances — the pair burns one fuel line. Behind it, Venus sextile Uranus at 1.7°, and Saturn sextile Uranus at 1.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Every angle named here holds for the whole of that day at the birthplace, so an unknown hour cannot take it away.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Jupiter opposes Uranus while both square Pluto. The t-square is the figure the old texts trusted for output: friction with a fixed address.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks four placements here. The Sun in Aries at 9.9° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Mercury in Pisces at 12.2° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Aries at 13.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Aquarius at 24.5° is in domicile. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Of the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: 4 in air, 3 in fire, 2 in water, 1 in earth by element, 6 cardinal, 2 mutable, 2 fixed by modality. Air weights a chart toward language and pattern — the impulse to name a thing before deciding how to feel about it. Jupiter, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.3° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 12.6°.
